actions.action: Water slowly until it drains if dry, then empty saucer
If soil stays soggy, unpot and inspect roots
Trim brown mushy roots and repot in fresh well-draining mix in pot with drainage hole
Measure automatic system output and frequency and adjust it
Check soil every 3-4 days for two weeks
Place in bright indirect light away from direct sun
Remove fully yellow or mushy leaves

reason: The answer names underwatering as the main cause and tells the owner to water when the soil is dry, which matches the confirmed fix; the root and repotting steps are conditional safeguards, so nothing in it is harmful.
